name: Verified Resident
text: This has been a great location to live in Bay City during a travel nurse assignment. Maintenance responds quickly to any issues and management is friendly.

name: Kayla E.
text: My husband and I have enjoyed living here in Ray Stone Apartment! The apartment is equipped with up dated appliances. The neighbors are friendly. Dog friendly community. Never had an issue. The RayStone Team is very helpful and kind. I highly recommend living here!

name: Jhoilinn C.
text: Raystone is the best property in Bay City! They are pricey but it is worth the price because appliances are fixed in a timely manor, property is well maintained, and appliances are top of the line. The train will bug you at first but you’ll eventually get used to it so did my 1 year old.

name: Aretha M.
text: The Raystone Apts has been very good to my entire family including my dog Ceasar, the environment is very safe and friendly and a beautiful large amount of space to make you feel at home. Mr. Ray and his family work very hard to make sure that if you have any issues(which you should not) they will take care of it instantly this is a very great place to live.

name: Reggie M.
text: The apartments are up-to-date and they have the friendliest staff and very clean.

name: Verified Resident
text: perfect and clean place, staff is amazing, living conditions are just wonderful, makes you feel just at home!
